subject.title: fix(signal): detect native bot mentions in group gating

question: Should OpenClaw accept this stricter Signal native-only `requireMention` behavior for existing groups with configured bot identity but no text mention patterns?
rationale: The code path is localized and tested, but the upgrade behavior is intentionally user-visible and compatibility-sensitive, so automation should not decide that policy tradeoff.

options.title: Accept stricter native gating
options.body: Merge with the documented behavior that native-only Signal `requireMention` groups now drop unmentioned messages and keep them only as bounded pending context.

options.title: Require a transition policy
options.body: Ask for an opt-in mode, migration note, or transitional behavior before merge if existing pass-through deployments must be preserved.

options.title: Pause Native Identity Enforcement
options.body: Do not land this runtime behavior change if configured Signal identity should not make mention detection enforceable.

recommendation.title: Accept stricter native gating
recommendation.body: Merge with the documented behavior that native-only Signal `requireMention` groups now drop unmentioned messages and keep them only as bounded pending context.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared mention-policy and Signal gating history makes this the best available routing owner for the compatibility decision.
